_why: Regression corpus for test/fuzz/builder-fuzz.test.ts. See ../corpus.ts for the two entry kinds and how to add one (PG_PRIME_FUZZ_RECORD=1).

cases.note: found on the same first live run: .distinct() with an orderBy on a column the random projection did not include is 42P10 `for SELECT DISTINCT, ORDER BY expressions must appear in select list`. Same class as 2802423309 and the same disposition: the generator narrows the ordering when distinct is present, the builder still lets a user write it.

found on the first live run: .distinct() over a projection carrying a `many` relation is 42883 `could not identify an equality operator for type json`. The generator no longer pairs the two (builder-generator.ts, userProjection's `json` option); the builder itself still lets a user write it — design/09 §3.7 books that with an owner.

the json/distinct class again, 5 000 live cases later: the first fix listed `many` and the two nested shapes as the json-projecting relation accessors and missed `all()`. Pinned because it is the seed that proved a partial fix is a fix that comes back.
